answer_1.quote: Hallucination, i.e., generated text lacking grounding in the input data, is a major challenge in neural data-to-text generation.

answer_2.quote: The system outputs were evaluated using standard automatic metrics - BLEU, METEOR and BERTScore - as well as measures particularly targeting hallucinations: BLEURT and the NLI-based metric proposed by ...

answer_4.quote: To verify the automatic metric results, we performed a small-scale in-house human evaluation. The annotation was performed by five NLP expert annotators...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assessed the presence of minor hallucinations, major hallucinations, omissions, disfluencies, and repetitions, and ranked system outputs from best to worst.
